background.rationale: Authored weakly curved wide-field support, anchored near the published local star/front scale. Gradient, curvature, extent and thickness outside the core are unmeasured continuity choices; no extrapolation of the small MUSE field is claimed.

features.rationale: Local star/front and equivalent emitting-layer scales from O Dell 2009 at 440 pc. Window, convex EW curvature amplitude and smooth blending are authored. No direct conversion of the 15-degree flow inclination into gas geometry.

Authored broad opening toward the observer in the southwest field. The location, depth and all coefficients are hypotheses for this initial wide-field visualization; they are not the 30-arcsecond OIII cavity or the neutral Veil.

interpretation: Evidence-guided visualization using one smooth irregular emitting front and locally tilted finite emission supports. Only central reference scales are paper-guided; full-field curvature, depth ordering, thickness and interpolation are authored. Separate Orion-S/foreground structures, absorption and a measured velocity fit remain unimplemented. RGB brightness determines projected emission, never depth.
